name: Agrolândia (Brazil)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and dark blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Agrolândia is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 23 February 1987 (prescribed by Municipal Law No. 509 of 23 February 1987, the arms by Law No. 508 of the same day, according to Flags of the World).
